exact_draft_slide_text: Things I want to do with you:

Spend a whole
Sunday in bed.

Coffee, croissants,
no plans except each other.

Order one of everything.

Laugh over dessert
as the lights start to dim.

I want to hold hands during drives,
even if it’s just to the store.

I want to cook dinners with you
and eat them al fresco.

My love language is
thinking, “you’d love this,”
at least ten times a day.

And quietly collecting those moments
until I can share them all with you.

a_story_rewrite_option_1: Small things I want with you:

A slow Sunday.
Two coffees.
No hurry to become useful.

Ordering too much dessert
and pretending it was planned.

Holding your hand on boring drives,
even when the destination is groceries.

Cooking something simple
and eating it before the lights come on.

Seeing tiny things all day
and thinking, you would love this.

Saving the ordinary moments
so I can give them to you later.
a_story_rewrite_option_2: The life I keep imagining with you:

Coffee in bed.
Crumbs on the sheet.
Nowhere else to be.

One table.
Too many desserts.
The same joke getting funnier.

Your hand in mine
on the most normal drive.

Dinner outside,
made badly maybe,
eaten happily anyway.

Finding things in shops
and hearing your reaction in my head.

Collecting small proof
that love was happening all day.
recommended_caption_for_exact_draft:
some futures are not grand.

just coffee.
dessert.
a boring drive.
dinner outside.
seeing something tiny and thinking of your person.

maybe that is the whole dream.
